title: Norml SEO Basics
pitch: Audit or fix a website’s SEO launch baseline with dependency-aware recipes and live evidence.
problem: A saved setting can fail to produce the expected public metadata, sitemap or tag behavior.
One output owner, recipe-specific checks and immutable reports make the baseline reviewable.

flow.d: Verify target, platform and existing owners.
Gather public, runtime, browser and source evidence.
Fix only explicitly requested mutable recipes.
Run acceptance and save the report.

items.name: Recipe catalog
items.desc: 15 recipes cover launch metadata, search properties, tags, assets and WordPress specifics.

items.name: Audit/fix modes
items.desc: Read-only is the default for run-through/check requests.

items.name: HTTP validator
items.desc: Source/asset/schema/sitemap checks for the WordPress baseline profile.

items.name: Current reporting
items.desc: Immutable full report plus one latest-state index.

items.name: Rank Math preservation
items.desc: The configuration template retains existing active modules and adds baseline modules idempotently.

items.role: One concern, ownership and rollback per file.

items: GA is presence-only; no property, stream, tag or version provisioning.
404 discovery is check-only; candidates require separate remediation review.
No keyword research, full technical audit or legal/privacy decisions.
Requires authorized platform/provider access for selected mutations.
